arguments.sql:
SELECT ml.city, ml.state, COUNT(*) AS fraud_transactions
FROM transactions t
JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT)
JOIN merchant_locations ml ON t.merchant_location_id = ml.id
WHERE f.is_fraud = 1
GROUP BY ml.city, ml.state
ORDER BY fraud_transactions DESC, ml.city, ml.state
arguments.explanation: This lists every city, with its state, where transactions labelled as fraud took place, and how many fraud transactions each one had. Cities with the most fraud come first.
assumptions: Only transactions with a fraud label of is_fraud = 1 are counted. Transactions without a label are left out.
Online transactions show up as their own row, with the city 'ONLINE' and an empty state.
Outside the US, the state column holds the country name.
